'''Candy''' was a hybrid [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] that was put together by the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Technician/Legends|mech-tech]] [[Geri]]. The Rodian built the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] by combining the head of an [[RX-series pilot droid/Legends|RX-Series pilot droid]] with the body of a [[P2-series astromech droid]], and he named it Candy because he considered the droid to be a "sweet tin can." Candy resided with Geri in the underground resistance base [[Mountain Home]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Toprawa/Legends|Toprawa]], and in [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]] Geri introduced Candy to the [[Whiplash]] operatives [[Den Dhur]] and [[I-5YQ]], who had been taken to Mountain Home after being rescued from their stricken [[Starship/Legends|starship]] by the [[Antarian Rangers/Legends|Antarian Rangers]].
